methodology.scope: Franchise lifetime; full season including playoffs unless the source itself is regular-season-only.
methodology.rivalries: Metric C: volume weighted regular 1, playoff 3, named bowl 5; plus series balance and close margins.
methodology.draft_value: Started Points minus same-season expectation for within-position draft rank.
methodology.draft_rounds: Average Started Points per franchise-season by round, compared with league team-season average.
methodology.forecast: Ordinary least-squares trend, clamped to the observed field size; display-only estimate.
